objective: Feature parity across every non-gold feature event; a medal requires accepted frontend behavior, not engine capability alone.

features.name: Seekbar thumbnail previews
features.acceptance: Accepted after a Windows desktop UI smoke on 2026-11-26 using a generated local AVC clip in PR #37's exact build (head 748ca7d). Pointer hover at two timeline positions displayed distinct preview frames labeled 00:01 and 00:02 while playback stayed paused at 00:03. A left click then sought to 00:02.13. The smoke verified preview positioning, pointer updates, no seek on hover, and seek on click in the actual desktop frontend. PR #23 implementation uses a separate paused libmpv client, 16 MiB bounded GPU LRU cache, coalesced requests, keyboard support and accessibility. Slint eligibility tests, real-media compositor pixel/bucket checks, and all seven exact-head hosted workflows passed. This acceptance covers Windows desktop behavior; hosted cross-platform tests cover the other builds.

features.name: Native picture in picture
features.acceptance: The base implementation is merged in PR #22: a compact always-on-top window with Play/Pause, Return and Close, preserving the prior size, position and window modes. Draft PR #36 (head ba4e45d) keeps the main player at its original size while opening PiP independently, copies and updates live frames and media state, clears stale frames for audio-only media or changed playback, forwards transport actions to the shared player callback, and keeps the View menu synchronized on Return/Close. Red/green UI tests cover the separate window lifecycle, copied/updated frames, current title/paused/status state, routed pause, hide/show, Return and menu state. All seven hosted checks passed on exact head ba4e45d: Code, Desktop UI, native helper, CodSpeed, Native controls, Windows packaging and Video compositor. Physical focus, multi-display behavior and physical multi-display presentation remain unverified; do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Gapless audio playback
features.acceptance:
PR #26 implements queued gapless playback and frontend selection/Stop behavior; its automatic-advance tests, native PCM capture, and virtual PulseAudio loopback pass. PR #46 adds a 44.1 kHz → 48 kHz transition. On exact head ad09d2c, a red/green synthetic analyzer test exposed that the previous analyzer tolerated up to 20 ms of internal silence despite the 5 ms-window criterion. It now rejects any complete quiet 5 ms window, accepts a sub-5 ms transition, and still ignores capture-edge silence. Local Windows feature-gated player-render tests passed 18/18; four native tests remain ignored because they require generated fixtures, libmpv, or PulseAudio. Formatting and diff checks pass. All seven exact-head hosted workflows pass. CodSpeed reports no performance change (279 unchanged cases; five optimized-out and two syscall-dominated cases are not measurable). Physical multi-track listening and Previous/Next acceptance remain pending, so keep in progress and do not award a medal.

On PR #46 head `4876f86`, the desktop test now confirms the queue selection follows native automatic advance. Local desktop tests passed 53/53 and the default-feature workspace coverage gate passed at 90.63%. Exact-head Code checks exposed a rustfmt-only layout issue on Windows and Linux; commit `311668c` applies the formatting correction. Fresh Code checks are queued at run 46096734099. Exact-head hosted checks on `311668c` are pending. Physical listening and Previous/Next queue-control acceptance remain pending; no medal is claimed.

On corrected exact head `311668c`, fresh Code checks are queued at run 46096734099; Desktop UI 46097059511, Video compositor 46097059496, Native playback controls 46097059467, and Native helper 46097059487 were dispatched and remain pending.

CI status refresh on corrected PR #46 head `311668c`: Code checks passed on Windows and Linux; macOS is queued. Native helper passed on Windows and Linux; macOS is queued. Desktop UI, compositor, and Native playback controls remain queued (runs 46096734099, 46097059511, 46097059496, 46097059467, and 46097059487). Physical listening and Previous/Next acceptance remain pending.

Exact-head CI refresh on PR #46 `311668c`: Video compositor, Windows packaging, Native playback controls, and CodSpeed passed; Code checks, Desktop UI, and native-helper passed on Windows/Linux, with their macOS jobs queued. Physical listening and Previous/Next acceptance remain pending.

Local Windows native PCM capture on PR #46 exact head `311668c`: generated 2-second mono 44.1 kHz and 48 kHz WAVs played through libmpv’s PCM writer. The capture reported 44.1 kHz, 176,400 samples, both 440 Hz and 880 Hz tracks, a 4,005 ms active span, and 0 ms longest internal silence. This is decoded PCM continuity evidence; physical device listening and Previous/Next acceptance remain pending. No medal is claimed.

features.name: DVD / Blu-ray structure playback
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #31 at 1ebdd08: DVD/Blu-ray folder and ISO selection, structure validation, disc-menu navigation, and a dispatch-path performance follow-up. The ISO9660 validator now reads and checks the complete 2,048-byte primary volume descriptor; a seven-byte truncated header is rejected. RED/GREEN state coverage plus the desktop picker callback verify rejection, queue/disc-state preservation, and valid DVD ISO/Blu-ray UDF dispatch. Windows full desktop tests passed 50/50, and the updated picker callback test passed after the final assertion. Workspace line coverage passed at 90.90% before that test-only assertion; strict desktop Clippy, rustfmt, and diff checks passed. All seven exact-head hosted workflows passed on 1ebdd08; CodSpeed showed no measured change across 279 comparable benchmarks (five optimized-out and three syscall-dominated cases are not measurable). Physical DVD/Blu-ray, packaged-runtime support, and licensing review remain pending; keep in_progress and claim no medal.

features.name: Chromecast video output
features.acceptance: Pinned transport, restricted file serving and owned playback APIs pass real TLS/HTTP fixtures. Owner-confirmed silent H.264 playback and pause/seek/resume/stop passed on two receivers during a 30-second window. The desktop Cast menu supports manual local-address entry, bounded in-app certificate inspection, explicit pin review, opt-in bounded mDNS discovery, worker controls and loaded local media with supported audio containers. Remember/forget for up to 32 explicitly reviewed local receiver pins is implemented in local user preferences. Physical desktop UI/discovery use and audible playback remain unverified; codecs beyond tested H.264 remain unverified. Keep in progress and claim no casting medal until those acceptance checks are complete.

features.name: Search and download subtitles
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #41 at head 067e957. The desktop Subtitles dialog searches OpenSubtitles by language, downloads validated SRT/ASS/SSA/WebVTT beside current local media, and adds the selection to playback. The API key stays in session memory; requests are bounded, cancellable, and HTTPS-only. Authenticated requests do not follow redirects; the API-key forwarding regression passed RED/GREEN. Closing the subtitle panel through Escape, its close button, or the outside area clears the visible key and cancels jobs; Escape is handled while either subtitle text field has focus. The exact-head desktop test explicitly focuses and edits the key field before Escape. Local optimized desktop tests passed (29/29), workspace coverage passed at 90.33%, strict Clippy and formatting passed. On 884f071, Desktop UI passed on Windows and Linux; Windows packaging, compositor, native playback controls, and CodSpeed passed; Code checks and native helper passed on Windows and Linux. All seven exact-head hosted workflows passed on 067e957, including the Windows and macOS desktop builds. The 1 MiB per-file transfer cap rejects oversized subtitle files before sidecar creation. Live provider/account behavior and visible playback against a real media file remain pending; no medal is claimed.

features.name: Touch or trackpad playback gestures
features.acceptance: The desktop video surface maps horizontal trackpad scrolling and horizontal touch drags to bounded relative seeks, and vertical scrolling/drags to volume. The software-window UI test covers 31px/32px drag thresholds, seek direction and ±15s clamps, volume 0–100 clamps, trackpad scrolling, and disabled playback state. Physical trackpad/touchscreen validation remains before acceptance; no feature medal is claimed. A Windows development-build smoke on 2026-11-26 loaded a generated H.264 clip: a 40 px horizontal drag from 0 s moved playback to 2 s; a 40 px downward drag changed volume 100→95; injected horizontal scrolling moved 2.97→1.97 s, and vertical scrolling changed volume 95→97.5. These were software mouse/scroll injections, not physical trackpad or touchscreen tests; those remain pending.

features.name: System media-control integration
features.acceptance: The shared playwire adapter connects Windows SMTC, macOS Now Playing, and Linux MPRIS. At merged PR #13 head e403070, all seven hosted checks passed, including the 90% full desktop/GPU coverage gate. Focused local Windows verification passed all 8 system-media tests and the full 31-test player-ui suite; strict UI Clippy passed with existing legacy-lint exceptions. Local default-workspace coverage was 93.64% (3,722/3,975 lines), but excludes feature-gated desktop/GPU code and is not a substitute for the hosted combined gate. On draft PR #38 head 7956695, Native playback controls run 45539812607 passed the real private-D-Bus MPRIS test: status, title/artist/album, transport capabilities, path privacy, and Play/Pause/PlayPause/Next/Previous/Seek routing were verified. CodSpeed, compositor, Windows packaging, and helper checks also passed on that head. The rustfmt-only correction is in a8c0174. All seven exact-head checks then passed: Code 45541566809, Desktop UI 45541566801, Native playback controls 45541566889, helper 45541566854, compositor 45541566786, Windows packaging 45541566795, and CodSpeed 45541566845. Physical session interaction and user-visible behavior on Windows, macOS, and Linux remain unverified; do not close the gap or claim a medal. A separate draft retry follow-up PR #43 classifies playwire Unavailable as retryable and config/unsupported errors as terminal; identical status messages are deduplicated and attempts remain one second apart. Its first hosted run found formatting-only differences; formatting corrections followed on heads 9f6a9e4 and 72e4b94; exact-head hosted workflows are still running. The corresponding Windows snapshot passed the 16-test desktop binary, strict player-UI Clippy, formatting, diff checks, and workspace coverage at 90.58% (5,722/6,317). Exact-head CI refresh for retry follow-up PR #43 (72e4b94) passed all seven workflows: Code checks 45879277020, Desktop UI 45879277037, Windows packaging 45879276988, compositor 45879277010, Native playback controls 45879276990, native helper 45879276992, and CodSpeed 45879277097. Physical OS media-session interaction remains pending; keep this gap in progress and claim no medal.

features.name: HD audio bitstream passthrough

All seven current-head hosted checks passed. Exact-head CodSpeed run 45459095782 reports 3 improved and 276 unchanged benchmarks, with no measured regressions; five optimized-out and one syscall-dominated case were excluded. This replaces the earlier 13.95% aggregate improvement claim; no aggregate performance claim is made. CI does not verify bitstream output. A compatible physical receiver/route must identify each claimed format with audible output, and decoded output must still work when passthrough is disabled. Do not close this gap or claim a medal.

Windows packaging passed; Code, Desktop UI, Native controls, native helper, and compositor are queued. features.name: Browse WebDAV media shares

Optional credentials remain ephemeral; they are sent only over HTTPS or loopback using bounded stdin configuration, and the password field clears when the panel closes. Service tests, 29 desktop tests, formatting, strict workspace Clippy, and the 90.58% workspace coverage gate passed locally. All seven exact-head hosted workflows passed: Code checks, Windows packaging, compositor, Desktop UI, CodSpeed, Native playback controls, and native helper. Real WebDAV server interaction remains pending; no medal is claimed.

features.name: Skip detected episode intros
features.acceptance:
PR #29 implements chapter/provider-based Skip Intro and PR #44 cancels stale IntroDB requests. PR #47 head 4fc3bdf adds red/green regressions for the exact marker-end boundary and visible desktop menu state: after IntroDB returns a marker, advancing the refreshed playback snapshot to its end hides Skip intro. The focused test failed before the end-exclusive fix and passes after it; full local Windows player-ui desktop tests pass 53/53. Workspace coverage passes at 93.02% (3,902/4,195 lines); formatting and diff checks pass. Six exact-head workflows were manually dispatched against 4fc3bdf and all passed: Code checks, Desktop UI on Windows/Linux/macOS, CodSpeed, Video compositor, Native playback controls, and Native helper on Windows/Linux/macOS. Windows release packaging was not run on this exact head because it requires a release tag; packaging passed on earlier head 566b470. The ignored live-provider test received one valid public API response for its requested episode on 2026-11-28. Real-episode playback and end-user seek behavior remain pending; keep in_progress and claim no medal.

On PR #47 head `d42f14a`, a red/green UI callback regression confirms Skip intro dispatches an absolute seek to the returned marker end. The full desktop suite passed 53/53 and workspace coverage passed at 90.02%. Hosted exact-head workflows have passed some jobs and remain queued or in progress for others. The earlier one-request public IntroDB provider result remains limited evidence; real-episode playback and user-visible seek behavior remain pending. No medal is claimed.

features.name: Music visualization display
features.acceptance: The audio visualization pipeline has desktop rendering and clears or refreshes the waveform filter when playback source/track state changes. Deterministic refresh budget: position-only snapshots reissue zero visualization-filter commands; media-path or track-list changes trigger a refresh. A red/green desktop regression covers the budget. Local Windows worktree snapshot b4bd517 passed the player-ui suite (57/57), workspace line coverage (90.46%), rustfmt and diff checks; this was not the exact current PR head. On PR #42 head c73dee1, Native playback controls, Native helper, Video compositor and Windows packaging passed; Code and Desktop UI passed on Windows/Linux with their macOS jobs queued. CodSpeed workflow succeeded but reported a predicted 18.5% degradation across the branch, with 56 significant comparisons on different hardware; treat performance comparison as inconclusive. Physical visual/audible acceptance and same-hardware resource/frame-pacing measurement remain required before acceptance; no medal is claimed.
